Refs: https://github.com/Astraive/praxor/issues/NUMBER
Spec: docs/specs/REPLACE-WITH-APPROVED-SPEC.md

## Summary

Describe the trigger/problem, resulting behavior and owning boundary. Use Closes only for fully verified issue scope; keep Refs for partial work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Copy each owning criterion and link its exact evidence. Link a carry-over issue for remaining scope.

## Verification

Record the tested head, exact commands, expected/actual outcomes, platform/fixture versions and independent review. Include failure, recovery or UI/host cases required by this change.

## Dependencies

Link parent, prerequisite and downstream issues using actual URLs. Explain interface/version compatibility and update native blocker relationships, milestone and Project fields.

## Compatibility and risks

Describe affected formats/APIs/platforms, migration or rollback, resource limits and documented unsupported behavior. Explain why a section is not applicable rather than leaving it blank.

## Delivery checklist

- [ ] The approved spec, issue criteria and affected docs match this diff.
- [ ] Commit subjects use type(scope): message and author/co-author credits are accurate.
- [ ] Required checks and independent review pass at the current head; intentional RED or incomplete work stays draft.
- [ ] Normal two-parent merge retains exact project attribution; close only verified scope, update Project #2 and delete the completed branch.
